WELCOME!
The Paulding County Recorder’s Office is responsible for maintaining a complete, accurate and permanent record of real estate documents such as deeds, mortgages and easements for all land within the county. We take great care to ensure that every document received is accurately filed, recorded and indexed.
All this information and documentation is available here on our website, 24-hours a day with no direct user cost. If you are not able to find what you need on this website, feel free to visit our office and we will be happy to assist you.
